category_title: Disruptive students who feel targeted and disrespected by authority figures
scenario_title: Classroom work and perceived unfair targeting
minimal_context: Kyle is coming into the classroom to take his seat and begin his daily classwork.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone, please take your seats and start your classwork. Kyle, what happened between you and Mrs. W? If you have problems today, I will write your name on the board.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I just came into class and sat down. Why are you bringing that up?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I'm just letting you know. You're like Mrs. W's son.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: That joke is weird. You're offending me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is enough talking back. I am putting your name on the board right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets loud) You started making me mad! When I'm doing my work and someone is bothering me, I'm the one that then gets in trouble! (Erases his name from the board when the teacher turns to look at the rest of the class)
